season.evidence: Stored Jun-Sep stands. Logged Clean Break ascents: Jun 2, Jul 2, Sep 1 (all peak ascents Jun 6, Jul 3, Aug 1, Sep 2). Web search: SR 20 (seasonal) gives access; a Mountain Project forum thread reports no snow on the Silver Star Creek approach apart from a steep patch at the base in summer; Mountaineers early-June Silver Star trips call that an early-season climb.

track.why: Logged route 'Clean Break' 10c; the track starts 186 m from our Silver Star Creek pullout pin, passes within 56 m of our summit pin, and continues down the Bench Camp/Burgundy Col trail to the Wine Spires pullout, which is exactly the descent our route text gives. 6 Jun 2015 falls inside Jun-Sep. Sparse (45 plotted points), so the line is coarse.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 24 Jul 2020, logged Clean Break, dense and good, but the recorded track only goes from the pullout to the base of the buttress (ends ~240 m horizontally and ~400 m vertically from the summit); the owner's rule wants a track that reaches the summit.

facts.text: In late July a short steep snow patch can still sit at the base of the route; approach shoes and a trekking pole were enough to cross it.
In early June snow covers parts of the approach and the talus below the east face, so expect slower travel.
Walking up the east side of Silver Star Creek from the pullout is mostly simple open cross-country to the base, with little bushwhacking if you pick your line.

notes: Summit pin is 4 m from Peakbagger's surveyed coordinate. Both recorded tracks start about 185 m from our TH pin, inside tolerance, so no TH change. Our other route on this peak (wa_zool_patch) was not in the packet's needing-a-track list.
